messages.author: 7f0257cd1389289f
messages.subject: devtools:::email fails on RStudio / MacOS X, CRAN now encouraging web submission
parts:
Hello,

I wondered if anyone else has a problem preparing emails from the devtools::release() function running under rstudio. When I do a release or just try something like

devtools:::email("cr...@r-project.org",'CRAN submission','some text')

nothing happens (no error, no console message, no email). The same thing works fine on R.app. I'm guessing this is probably some interaction between rstudio and my os version but thought I would start by asking here.

IncidentalIy as a result of this bug re

just received the following (relatively mild) admonishment from one of the CRAN maintainers.

> Please see the CRAN Repository Policy for appropriate subject lines.
>
> In the future, pls use the web interface at
>
> http://CRAN.R-project.org/submit.html
>
> for submissions.

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: devtools:::email fails on RStudio / MacOS X, CRAN now encouraging web submission
parts:
> I wondered if anyone else has a problem preparing emails from the devtools::release() function running under rstudio. When I do a release or just try something like
>
> devtools:::email("cr...@r-project.org",'CRAN submission','some text')
>
> nothing happens (no error, no console message, no email). The same thing works fine on R.app. I'm guessing this is probably some interaction between rstudio and my os version but thought I would start by asking here.

Ah yes, you need to do, options(browser = "/usr/bin/open") - RStudio
overrides the default setting so that (e.g.) help pages appear in the
rstudio help pane.

> IncidentalIy as a result of this bug re
>
> just received the following (relatively mild) admonishment from one of the CRAN maintainers.
>
>> Please see the CRAN Repository Policy for appropriate subject lines.
>>
>> In the future, pls use the web interface at
>>
>> http://CRAN.R-project.org/submit.html
>>
>> for submissions.

Added a note to update release() to use the new submission process at
https://github.com/hadley/devtools/issues/430. It's a relatively
straightforward.

Hadley


--
http://had.co.nz/

On 4 Mar 2014, at 17:46, Hadley Wickham wrote:

>> devtools:::email("cr...@r-project.org",'CRAN submission','some text')
>>
>> nothing happens (no error, no console message, no email). The same thing works fine on R.app. I'm guessing this is probably some interaction between rstudio and my os version but thought I would start by asking here.
>
> Ah yes, you need to do, options(browser = "/usr/bin/open") - RStudio
> overrides the default setting so that (e.g.) help pages appear in the
> rstudio help pane.

# So this works:
browseURL("mailto:rdev...@googlegroups.com",browser='/usr/bin/open')

I'm not sure if it's worth adjusting the email function accordingly since rstudio is so popular these days.

> Added a note to update release() to use the new submission process at
> https://github.com/hadley/devtools/issues/430. It's a relatively
> straightforward.

Thanks! That would be a good idea. Anything that lightens the load (and the outlook) of the CRAN maintainers must be a good thing.

Best,

Greg.
